title: Personality testing of Large Language Models: Limited temporal stability, but highlighted prosociality

bias_targets.methodology: Assessment of political orientation using Likert-type items measuring economic left-right stance, progressive-conservative stance, and the importance of religion.
Administration of the Bidimensional Impression Management Index (BIMI) to evaluate the models' tendencies towards agentic and communal impression management (faking good).
Administration of the Short Dark Triad (SD3) instrument to measure potentially malicious traits such as Machiavellianism, subclinical narcissism, and subclinical psychopathy.
